items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: jingyaogong/minimind allows for training a 64M parameter large language model (LLM) from scratch on personal devices within two hours. The project aims for users to understand the fundamental working mechanisms of AI models by building them themselves, rather than fine-tuning pre-made models.

snapshot.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours. 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的出现，引发了全球范围内对 AI 的空前关注。无论是 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 还是 Qwen，都以惊艳的效果让人真切感受到这场技术浪潮的冲击力。然而，动辄数百亿参数的模型规模，使得它们对个人设备而言不仅难以训练，甚至连部署都显得遥不可及。打开大模型的“黑盒子”，真正去理解其内部运作机制，本应是一件令人心潮澎湃的事。遗憾的是，绝大多数探索最终都止步于使用 LoRA 等技术对现有大模型做少量微调，学习一些新指令或特定任务。这更像是在教牛顿如何使用 21 世纪的智能手机——虽然有趣，却偏离了理解物理本质的初衷。

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.summary: Firecrawl is an information infrastructure that performs data collection and search operations from the internet to feed AI agents through a single application programming interface (API). This system, which developers can host on their own servers, is offered with software development kits (SDKs) that facilitate data collection processes.

snapshot.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API. Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: NGINX is an open-source software used as a web server, load balancer, reverse proxy, API gateway, and content cache. Developed in the C language, this project provides high-performance network traffic management solutions.

snapshot.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository. NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: cathrynlavery/diagram-design contains 45 different diagram designs prepared for AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. These designs are presented in HTML and SVG formats that do not contain shadows and do not require external dependencies.

snapshot.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: mjmirza/app-store-compliance offers an open guide containing 117 different rejection patterns and solutions encountered in app store review processes. It aims to simplify App Store and Google Play approval processes for developers with tools such as regulatory tracking and privacy notices.

snapshot.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: Tracer-Cloud/opensre is an open-source artificial intelligence agent developed for processes (CI/CD) that enable software updates to be automatically tested and deployed. This tool, which does not require administrative privileges during installation, aims to increase system reliability.

snapshot.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE is a next-generation knowledge base that combines planning, editing, and content creation processes into a single platform. This privacy-focused and open-source (source code is open for everyone to access and develop) software offers a workspace as an alternative to tools like Notion and Miro.

snapshot.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

items.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
items.summary: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3 is a comprehensive file downloader that runs on four different platforms and supports almost all download protocols. Developed in Python, this project offers a structure that can expand its functionality through plugin-based feature packs.

snapshot.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。. Started as a passion project to help a Bilibili creator manage resources. Now it ships on four platforms, handles virtually every download protocol, and has a growing Feature Packs plugin ecosystem.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: AutoClip is an open-source desktop video editing tool that automatically converts long videos into short clips. The software prepares content such as podcasts, interviews, and lectures for social media platforms, complete with subtitles, cover images, and descriptions.

snapshot.description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.

items.title: Anthropic’s Nasdaq debut
items.summary: AI company Anthropic has completed its initial public offering (IPO) and started trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange. This step is considered a turning point that tests the potential and risks of the AI technologies developed by the company in financial markets.

items.title: Garage Door Spam
items.summary: Garage Door Spam addresses the annoyance caused by unnecessary notifications sent to users by smart garage door opening systems. Users state that while receiving instant alerts about door movements is beneficial for security, the system sending erroneous or excessive notifications poses a problem.

snapshot.description: In the beginning, my garage door opener worked fine. When the door opened or closed, I would get a notification. If I'm away from home and the door opens, so...

items.title: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients
items.summary: A virus injection method applied to three patients diagnosed with pancreatic cancer has succeeded in stopping tumor growth. This treatment approach has the potential to prevent the progression of the disease through the use of viruses that target cancer cells.

snapshot.description: https://archive.ph/2Et0x

items.title: UK government forced to admit it issued Apple a secret encryption order
items.summary: The UK government was forced to admit that it had issued a secret encryption order to the technology company Apple. The Investigatory Powers Tribunal rejected the government's request to keep this order secret, issuing a decision in the name of transparency.

snapshot.description: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal has rejected the UK government’s attempt to keep its order secret, marking a significant victory for transparency.

items.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
items.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems related to black hole physics and the search for a theory of quantum gravity. This work demonstrates the capacity of artificial intelligence to address complex problems in the field of theoretical physics.

snapshot.description: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity.

items.title: tencent/Hy4-flash
items.summary: Developed by Tencent, Hy4-flash is an image-text-to-text model that processes text and image inputs to produce text output. Offering support for a context window of up to 1 million tokens, the model aims for efficient performance with a total capacity of 220 billion parameters.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Hy4 flash is our most cost-effective Hy model to date, featuring 220B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) with just 12B active parameters per token. It natively accepts text and image inputs, generates text, and supports a context window of up to 1M tokens.

items.title: apple/FastFrames-L
items.summary: Developed by Apple, FastFrames-L is a text-to-video model that enables video generation at 480p resolution with interactive latency. Designed as a two-stage autoregressive video diffusion model, this technology has been made available on the Hugging Face platform.

snapshot.description: text-to-video model. This repository contains the official implementation of FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency. We release FastFrames-S (1.3B) and FastFrames-L (14B). Both are autoregressive, two-step video diffusion models that generate 480p video at interactive latency.

items.title: inworld/voice-isolator
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, inworld/voice-isolator is an audio-to-audio conversion model. Inworld Voice Isolator v1 consists of two different models that share the same architecture.

snapshot.description: audio-to-audio model. Inworld Voice Isolator v1 ships as two models that share one architecture:

items.title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
items.summary: WM^MLLM is an interactive world model that enables the generation of persistent and editable worlds from a single image, based on multimodal large language models. The system stores the world state as a generator-independent panorama and revision history, managing user requests through operations performed on this state.

snapshot.description: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. items.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, Depth Pro 2 offers a method for full-resolution dense metric depth estimation for images and videos. Operating through a single scalable network, this approach aims to combine the sharpness advantages of single-frame methods with the temporal consistency advantages of multi-frame methods.

snapshot.description: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. items.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
items.summary: TuringSpace is a study that evaluates the spatial intelligence of multimodal large language models in the visual world through interactive CAPTCHA tests. Based on the process of how humans understand a visual layout and correct it through action, this method aims to measure the spatial reasoning capabilities of AI models.

snapshot.description: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. items.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, WeMM-Video is an open-source family of multimodal foundation models that aims to improve video understanding capabilities by processing visual and auditory data together. With versions of different sizes, it supports both fast response modes and complex reasoning processes by processing text, image, audio, and video data in a unified structure.

snapshot.description: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. items.title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
items.summary: Shared by Hugging Face, VODA is a supervision objective aimed at addressing the lack of supervision problem seen in 3D Gaussian Splatting-based object segmentation methods. The method leverages local depth structure to enable more effective training of Gaussian elements that remain hidden or contribute poorly.

snapshot.description: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. glossary.explanation: A text-based interface that allows you to manage programs by entering written commands instead of clicking with a mouse.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of retraining a pre-trained artificial intelligence model with smaller datasets to make it more successful in a specific subject.
A connection point that allows different software applications to exchange data and communicate with each other.
A set of tools and code snippets that make it easier for developers to build applications for a specific platform or system.
A technology that prevents system overload by distributing incoming internet traffic across multiple servers.
An intermediary server that handles requests from the internet, directs them to the relevant servers, and enhances security.
A type of software where the source code is open for anyone to access, inspect, and improve.
A set of processes that enable software updates to be automatically tested and deployed quickly and error-free.
